players.product: BUZZ HPC GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB200 / GB300 / B200 / H200 clusters in Bell AI Fabric data centers in Canada) plus HPC colocation conversions of owned sites (Boden Sweden, Toronto gigafactory)

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's Q1 FY2027 results release (8-K exhibit): 1,004 Bitcoin were received as rewards in the quarter, up 147% year-over-year from 406 Bitcoin in fiscal Q1 2026, driven by average operational hashrate of 24.0 EH/s versus 8.7 EH/s in fiscal Q1 2026; BUZZ HPC revenue of $7.1 million was up 52.1% sequentially, driven by the NVIDIA B200 GPU cluster at its Manitoba, Canada site and demand and pricing across GPU marketplaces.
quarterly_data.figure: 1,004 Bitcoin (vs 406, +147% YoY); average hashrate 24.0 EH/s (vs 8.7 EH/s); HPC revenue +52.1% QoQ

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's Q1 FY2027 results release (8-K exhibit): HIVE operates approximately 440 MW of global power capacity and expects its energized footprint to reach approximately 540 MW after the planned energization of an additional 100 MW PPA at Yguazú in the fourth quarter of calendar 2026 (the additional capacity is currently unallocated). Beyond calendar 2026, its Tier-III development pipeline, including 70 MW in New Brunswick, Toronto and Little Boden and the planned 320 MW GTA Gigafactory, supports a longer-term target of approximately $700 million of total HPC ARR by year-end 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: ~440 MW operating; ~540 MW energized after 100 MW Yguazú PPA in Q4 CY2026; 70 MW + planned 320 MW GTA Gigafactory Tier-III pipeline

connects_to.relationship: GPU cloud compute (NVIDIA GB200 cluster at Bell AI Fabric's Merritt, B.C. facility) on which Cohere operates its foundation models

contracts.signal: HIVE's Q1 FY2027 results release (8-K exhibit): the approximately $225 million, three-year sovereign AI agreement with Bell AI Fabric supporting Cohere covers the deployment of 2,304 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 GPUs and adds $75 million of ARR to the approximately $35 million of GPU Cloud ARR currently live.
contracts.value: approximately $225 million over three years ($75 million ARR)
